title: Safarka Nafta La Qaatay
intro: Waqtigii ay caadooyinka bulshadu gacanta ku hayeen, qof gaar ah ayaa la kulmay isbeddel qoto dheer oo ku yimid guri barakeysan. Sheekadooda, oo lagu calaamadeeyay xiriir jacayl iyo amar rabbaani ah, waxay muujinaysaa jebinta dhaqankii hore iyo aasaaska mabaadi'da cusub ee xaqa ah. Sheekadani waxay iftiiminaysaa muhiimadda ay runtu ka leedahay dhaqanka iyo xikmadda ka dambeysa amarrada Alle.
clues: Mar baan maxbuus ahaa, laakiin iyada oo loo marayo hab-raaca rabbaaniga ah, waxaan helay guri iyo qoys cusub.
Aad baan u jeclaa oo markii la i siiyay doorasho qoyskaygii dhalay iyo qofka aan korsaday, waxaan doortay inaan la joogo kan dambe.
Magacaygu wuxuu mar la xiriiri jiray qofka aan korsaday, taasoo ah dhaqan caadi ka ahaa bulshadayda.
Aniga ayaa ah saaxiibka kaliya ee nebiga ugu dambeeya ee magaciisa si cad loogu sheegay Qur'aanka.
Waxaan guursaday haweeney sharaf leh oo ay ilmaadeer ahaayeen nebiga, laakiin guurkeennu ma sii socon.
Furriinkaygii ka dib, Alle laftiisu wuxuu amray in xaaskaygii hore ay guursato Nabiga, taasoo meesha ka saartay caado qadiimi ah oo ku saabsan korsashada.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Amarka rabbaaniga ah ee ku saabsan guurkayga iyo furriinkayga

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
